WHAT_WENT_WRONG_IN_V1_AND_IT_WAS_MY_RUNN.WHAT_IS_NOT_CHANGED: Not one threshold. The classification rule, the eligibility set, the outcome definition, Q3_B's +0.10 margin and Q3_C's CI requirement are all carried over unchanged. Only the DEFINITION OF THE CONTROL changes, from a bootstrap of one permutation to a proper permutation null.
WHAT_WENT_WRONG_IN_V1_AND_IT_WAS_MY_RUNN.it_is_not_retroactively_passed: v1's Q3 arm stands at 3/4 and is published as such. A defective control is corrected in a NEW specification; it is never re-scored in place after the fact.
WHAT_WENT_WRONG_IN_V1_AND_IT_WAS_MY_RUNN.the_consequence: The v1 control reported a 90 percent CI of [-0.1214, -0.0235], excluding 0, and Q3_D was scored FAILED. That failure is a defect in my runner, not a property of the data.
WHAT_WENT_WRONG_IN_V1_AND_IT_WAS_MY_RUNN.the_gate: Q3_D said 'with outcome labels permuted, the 90 percent CI contains 0'.
WHAT_WENT_WRONG_IN_V1_AND_IT_WAS_MY_RUNN.what_the_runner_did: It drew ONE permutation and then BOOTSTRAPPED that single permuted labelling. That estimates the sampling spread around whatever value the one permutation happened to land on -- it does not estimate the permutation null at all.

anti_immunisation: No threshold moved. v1's failure is published in full alongside this. REFUTED, UNTESTABLE-HERE and BLOCKED stay distinct.

carried_over_unchanged.classification: SYSTEMIC = a node in the top quartile of BOTH total Q1 degree (multi-tenant) AND U = Interbank_liabilities / Equity (leverage). ROUTINE = every other eligible node. Quartiles are computed within the eligible set; there is no fitted parameter and the outcome is never consulted.
carried_over_unchanged.substrate: The 2016Q1/Q2 interbank network, same eligibility and same realised withdrawal outcome as spec db8c3a4f: 1349 eligible nodes, 291 events.

gates.bar: each class has >= 50 nodes and >= 10 realised withdrawal events
withdrawal rate SYSTEMIC minus ROUTINE >= +0.10. UNCHANGED from v1.
90 percent bootstrap CI on the difference excludes 0, 2000 resamples. UNCHANGED from v1.
over 2000 INDEPENDENT permutations the null's 90 percent band contains 0 AND the observed difference falls outside that band
UNTESTABLE-HERE. An intervention. Historical data cannot answer it and the only alternative substrate is a simulator we wrote.

model: Licensing Q3 - v2, corrected permutation control
scope: Q3 ONLY. Q4 and Q5 are not re-run and their v1 results stand exactly as reported.

the_corrected_control.method: Draw 2000 INDEPENDENT permutations of the outcome labels. For each, recompute the systemic-minus-routine withdrawal rate difference. The resulting distribution is the permutation null.
the_corrected_control.the_gate: the null's 90 percent band must CONTAIN 0, and the observed difference must fall OUTSIDE it.
the_corrected_control.why_both_halves: A null centred on 0 shows the classification is not manufacturing a difference by itself. The observed value falling outside that band is what makes the measured difference more than noise. Requiring only the first would be a control that cannot bite.

what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.would: That the systemic/routine classification separates realised withdrawal risk on one real network in one quarter, by more than permutation noise.
what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.would_NOT: That assigning Al-Qudah's instrument to one class and Irfan's to the other improves any outcome. That is an intervention and nothing here tests it.
